title: IT wants remote control
scenario: A caller ID shows the company help desk. The caller says your laptop is beaconing to a malicious server and asks you to install a remote-support tool and sign in so they can “clean the token cache.”

answers.A: Install the tool but watch the screen closely and stop the session if they open email or finance systems.
answers.B: End the call and contact IT through the official help desk or ticket system before installing or granting remote access.
answers.C: Disconnect from sensitive systems and create an IT ticket through the normal channel.

explanation: Remote-control access can expose tokens and credentials before anything obviously suspicious appears.
proTip: Verify support before support controls the device.
